title: Playing with Albert Burbank, then leading his own band
summary: Jiles was with Burbank when Bill Russell recorded him, then led a small band with Joe Snider, Earl Bourne and Lester Lewis.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Well, it'll come to you. Don't worry about it too long. Let's see. You told before about that band with Lester Lewis and Burbank and Talbot and different things. Who were you playing with when Bill Russell came down here to record you?
Albert Burbank. You were playing with Burbank.
And then what band did you go with?
After Burbank, I had my own band after that.
Where was that at? You mean?
Where did you play? Well different places. I mean it was no regular study place, but playing different jobs in different places.
Well at that time I had Joe Snighy playing trumpet. I had Earl Bourne playing saxophone. And Lester Lewis playing piano. About stuff
